queries: WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), a AS (SELECT c.*, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM c) AS excess FROM c), r AS (SELECT a.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rnk FROM a WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM c)) SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, excess FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY excess DESC, circuitId

WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), s AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, race_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS excess FROM s), f AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, excess, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rnk FROM a WHERE excess > 0) SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, excess AS share_above_average FROM f WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY excess DESC, circuitId

WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), a AS (SELECT c.*, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM c), r AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, share - avg_share AS excess, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share - avg_share DESC) AS rk FROM a WHERE share > avg_share) SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, excess FROM r WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY excess DESC, circuitId

responses.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), a AS (SELECT c.*, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM c) AS excess FROM c), r AS (SELECT a.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rnk FROM a WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM c)) SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, excess FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY excess DESC, circuitId

assumptions.assumption: The average share across circuits is the mean of the per-circuit shares, taken over circuits that have at least one race in races. This equals 1 divided by the number of such circuits. Circuits with no races are excluded.
Ties at 10th place are handled with RANK() on the excess, so every circuit tied with the 10th is included.

assumptions.assumption: The average share across circuits is taken over circuits that have at least one race in races (i.e. 1 / number of distinct races.circuitId), not over all rows in the circuits table.
Ties with the 10th circuit are included by using RANK() on the excess, so more than 10 rows may be returned.

assumptions.assumption: The average share is taken over circuits that appear in races (circuits with no races are excluded), so it equals 1 divided by the number of such circuits.
Ties with the 10th circuit are included using RANK() over the excess. Circuits with equal race counts have equal excess.
